<header class="page-heading"><p class="eyebrow">District Court starter template</p><h1>Proposed Order</h1><p>Use this neutral format when a proposed order is submitted with a motion or other request for court action.</p></header>

<article class="filing-template">
  <p class="filing-template__notice"><strong>Template use.</strong> A proposed order is not effective unless and until entered by the Court. Draft the operative language precisely and remove advocacy from the order itself.</p>
  <div class="filing-template__document">
    <div class="filing-template__caption"><p><strong>UNITED STATES DISTRICT COURT</strong></p><p><strong>DISTRICT OF COLUMBIA</strong></p><h2>[CASE CAPTION]</h2><p>Case No. [DOCKET NUMBER]</p></div>
    <h2>PROPOSED ORDER</h2>
    <p>Upon consideration of <span class="template-placeholder">[identify motion / request]</span>, the record, and any response thereto, it is hereby:</p>
    <section class="filing-template__section"><h3>ORDERED</h3><p class="template-placeholder">[Set out the precise relief to be granted, denied, or otherwise directed.]</p></section>
    <section class="filing-template__section"><h3>Further provisions</h3><p class="template-placeholder">[Deadlines, conditions, service requirements, or other operative terms, if applicable.]</p></section>
    <div class="filing-template__field"><strong>Date</strong><span class="template-placeholder">[Court use]</span></div>
    <div class="filing-template__field"><strong>Judge</strong><span class="template-placeholder">[Court use]</span></div>
  </div>
</article>
